text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Hey~ Cesario...
You really are amazing, Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Eh, Craft...? 
Where did this come from all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
You're so independent and mature, right? 
So over the weekend, I tried copying you——

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: 'While visiting home, I did the laundry, cleaning... and even cooked! Look, look, Dad! How is it?'

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text: 'Ohh, you worked hard! ...Wait a second! Did you make sure to turn off the gas and water taps properly?'

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: I wanted him to say something like, 'I have nothing to worry about leaving things to you, Craft!'~.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... But I'm sure your father was really happy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
I mean, sure, but... that's not enough! 
He has to acknowledge how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Mmh... I'm not giving up~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
How I've shown my grown-up self
to others... is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I once conveyed my gratitude to my mother in writing.
It allows you to show emotional maturity that's hard to express face-to-face.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: '...Um, this is kind of sudden, but I wanted to express my thanks. Thank you, Dad', send!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: 'Thanks so much! ——Wait, what time is it? Shouldn't you be heading to bed soon?'

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Mmh... It's only 8 PM~...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
You want your father to recognize your growth? 
Fufu, I see. In that case——

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Quite simply, dress up! 
Maturity begins with one's appearance♪ Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: S-Surely when he sees this photo——!

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text: 'You look lovely! But that looks a bit light for the weather. After dressing up so nicely, what if you catch a cold...?'

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: LIKE I SAID, THAT'S NOT THE POINTTTTTT——!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: If it's come to this... it's time for the ultimate secret art!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
So, um! 
When all else fails, magic is the answer...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? How should I know! 
I'm busy testing a new concoction! 
Don't get in my way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Now then, all that's left is to gather the medicinal herbs I noted down earlier——

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Wah! The book is completely covered in notes... 
Did you write all of these, Sweep-san?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ That's right! 
Ever since I watched Grandma do magic beside her!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: When Grandma saw the sheer amount of notes, she told me, 'Would you like to try concocting on your own from now on?'! It's that impressive!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: That makes total sense! With this many notes, anyone can see at a glance how hard you worked... ——Ah!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so that's it.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san! I won't get in your way! 
In fact, I'll help you with your magic! So——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while heading outside for a change of pace,
I spotted Line Craft pulling weeds.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! I'm gathering medicinal herbs! 
There's something I need Sweep-san's help with!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Though I haven't been able to find the herbs I'm looking for at all. Ahaha...
choice_data_list: What kind of herbs are you looking for, by the way?
I'll help you out as well.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Though I haven't been able to find the herbs I'm looking for at all. Ahaha...
choice_data_list: What kind of herbs are you looking for, by the way?
I'll help you out as well.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: The flowers are purple so they're easy to spot, but apparently they're really tiny—
choice_data_list: Must be tough to find them.
Must be tough to find them, huh.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: But that's totally fine! The weather's so nice, it's like... basking in the sun while searching♪

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Fufufu~n♪ All right, let's do our best~!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: I'm really happy for the offer! ...But this is for my own sake!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: So don't worry, I'm okay! If I don't find it with my own hands, it won't mean anything!
